1.9 Partial fraction decomposition

Integrals like

∫3x+11x2−x−6d⁡ ⁣x\int \frac{3x+11}{x^2-x-6} \d{x}∫x2−x−63x+11​dx
(1)

can be evaluated by breaking them apart into simpler integrals. Let’s try to break the integrand up into the factors of its denominator:

3x+11x2−x−6=3x+11(x−3)(x+2)=A1x−3+A2x+2\frac{3x+11}{x^2-x-6} = \frac{3x+11}{(x-3)(x+2)} = \frac{A_1}{x-3} + \frac{A_2}{x+2}x2−x−63x+11​=(x−3)(x+2)3x+11​=x−3A1​​+x+2A2​​
(2)

To find A1A_1A1​ and A2A_2A2​, first cross multiply to eliminate the denominator, then combine like powers of x:

3x+11=A1(x+2)+A2(x−3)3x+11=(A1+A2)x+(2A1−3A2)\begin{align} 3x + 11 &= A_1(x+2) + A_2(x-3) \\ 3x + 11 &= (A_1 + A_2)x + (2A_1 - 3A_2) \\ \end{align}3x+113x+11​=A1​(x+2)+A2​(x−3)=(A1​+A2​)x+(2A1​−3A2​)​​
(3)

If our proposed form will work, all the coefficients of x must match on both sides, so

A1+A2=32A1−3A2=11\begin{align} A_1 + A_2 &= 3 \\ 2A_1 - 3A_2 &= 11 \end{align}A1​+A2​2A1​−3A2​​=3=11​​
(4)

This is a system of linear equations that can be solved, e.g., using a matrix technique. Form the augmented matrix then perform Gauss-Jordan elimination:

[1132−311]R1−2R1→[1130−55]R1÷−5→[11301−1]−R2R2→[10401−1]\begin{align} \begin{bmatrix} 1 & 1 & 3\\ 2 & -3 & 11 \end{bmatrix} \begin{matrix}\vphantom{R_1} \\ -2 R_1 \end{matrix} &\to \begin{bmatrix} 1 & 1 & 3\\ 0 & -5 & 5 \end{bmatrix} \begin{matrix}\vphantom{R_1} \\ \div -5 \end{matrix} \\ &\to \begin{bmatrix} 1 & 1 & 3\\ 0 & 1 & -1 \end{bmatrix} \begin{matrix} -R_2 \\ \vphantom{R_2} \end{matrix} \\ &\to \begin{bmatrix} 1 & 0 & 4\\ 0 & 1 & -1 \end{bmatrix} \end{align}[12​1−3​311​]R1​−2R1​​​→[10​1−5​35​]R1​÷−5​→[10​11​3−1​]−R2​R2​​→[10​01​4−1​]​​
(5)

so A1=4A_1 = 4A1​=4 and A2=−1A_2 = -1A2​=−1. Once you have coefficients, you can integrate:

∫3x+11x2−x−6d⁡ ⁣x=∫(4x−3−1x+2)d⁡ ⁣x=4ln⁡∣x−3∣−ln⁡∣x+2∣+c\begin{align} \int \frac{3x+11}{x^2-x-6} \d{x} &= \int\left(\frac{4}{x-3}-\frac{1}{x+2} \right) \d{x} \\ &= 4\ln| x-3 | - \ln|x+2| + c \end{align}∫x2−x−63x+11​dx​=∫(x−34​−x+21​)dx=4ln∣x−3∣−ln∣x+2∣+c​​
(6)

We can formalize this technique, called partial fraction decomposition.

Partial fraction decomposition

For a rational polynomial P(x)/Q(x)P(x)/Q(x)P(x)/Q(x) where Q is expressed using either linear or irreducible quadratic factors and the degree of P is less than Q, propose the following decomposition:

  • Linear factor ax+bax+bax+b

    Aax+b\frac{A}{ax+b}ax+bA​
    (7)

  • Repeated linear factor (ax+b)k(ax+b)^k(ax+b)k

    A1ax+b+⋯+Ak(ax+b)k\frac{A_1}{ax+b} + \cdots + \frac{A_k}{(ax+b)^k}ax+bA1​​+⋯+(ax+b)kAk​​
    (8)

  • Irreducible quadratic factor ax2+bx+cax^2 + bx + cax2+bx+c

    Ax+Bax2+bx+c\frac{Ax+B}{ax^2+bx+c}ax2+bx+cAx+B​
    (9)

  • Repeated irreducible quadratic factor (ax2+bx+c)k(ax^2 + bx+c)^k(ax2+bx+c)k

    A1x+B1ax2+bx+c+⋯+Akx+Bk(ax2+bx+c)k\frac{A_1 x + B_1}{ax^2+bx+c} + \cdots + \frac{A_k x + B_k}{(ax^2+bx+c)^k}ax2+bx+cA1​x+B1​​+⋯+(ax2+bx+c)kAk​x+Bk​​
    (10)

To demonstrate this technique, let’s try to take the integral

∫x2−29x+5(x−4)2(x2+3)d⁡ ⁣x\int \frac{x^2-29x+5}{(x-4)^2 (x^2+3)} \d{x}∫(x−4)2(x2+3)x2−29x+5​dx
(11)

First, expand the denominator and put placeholder coefficient terms in the numerator.

x2−29x+5(x−4)2(x2+3)=A1x−4+A2(x−4)2+A3x+B3x2+3\frac{x^2-29x+5}{\left(x-4 \right)^2 \left(x^2+3 \right)} = \frac{A_1}{x-4} + \frac{A_2}{(x-4)^2} + \frac{A_3x+ B_3}{x^2+3}(x−4)2(x2+3)x2−29x+5​=x−4A1​​+(x−4)2A2​​+x2+3A3​x+B3​​
(12)

Next, cross multiply, expand, and collect like powers of x:

x2−29x+5=A1(x−4)(x2+3)+A2(x2+3)+(A3x+B3)(x−4)2=A1(x3−4x2+3x−12)+A2(x2+3)+(A3x+B3)(x2−8x+16)=(A1+A3)x3+(−4A1+A2−8A3+B3)x2+(3A1+16A3−8B3)x+(−12A1+3A2+16B3)\begin{align} x^2-29x+5 &= A_1 \left(x-4 \right) \left(x^2+3 \right) + A_2 \left(x^2+3 \right) \\ &\quad + \left(A_3x+B_3 \right) \left(x-4 \right)^2 \\ &= A_1 \left(x^3-4x^2+3x-12 \right) + A_2 \left(x^2+3 \right) \\ &\quad +\left(A_3x+B_3 \right)\left(x^2-8x+16 \right) \\ &=\left(A_1+A_3\right)x^3+\left(-4A_1+A_2-8A_3+B_3\right)x^2 \\ &\quad + \left(3A_1+16A_3-8B_3\right)x+\left(-12A_1+3A_2+16B_3\right) \end{align}x2−29x+5​=A1​(x−4)(x2+3)+A2​(x2+3)+(A3​x+B3​)(x−4)2=A1​(x3−4x2+3x−12)+A2​(x2+3)+(A3​x+B3​)(x2−8x+16)=(A1​+A3​)x3+(−4A1​+A2​−8A3​+B3​)x2+(3A1​+16A3​−8B3​)x+(−12A1​+3A2​+16B3​)​​
(13)

Finally, form the linear system of equations for the coefficients of x:

A1+A3=0−4A1+A2−8A3+B3=13A1+16A3−8B3=−29−12A1+3A2+16B3=5\begin{align} A_1+A_3 &= 0 \\ -4A_1 + A_2-8A_3 + B_3 &=1 \\ 3A_1 + 16A_3 - 8B_3 &= -29 \\ -12A_1+3A_2+16B_3 &=5 \\ \end{align}A1​+A3​−4A1​+A2​−8A3​+B3​3A1​+16A3​−8B3​−12A1​+3A2​+16B3​​=0=1=−29=5​​
(14)

These linear equations can be written using a matrix and vectors

[1010−41−813016−8−123016][A1A2A3B3]=[01−295]\begin{bmatrix} 1 & 0 & 1 & 0\\ -4 & 1 & -8 & 1\\ 3 & 0 & 16 & -8\\ -12 & 3 & 0 & 16 \end{bmatrix} \begin{bmatrix} A_1 \\ A_2\\ A_3\\ B_3 \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} 0\\ 1\\ -29 \\ 5 \end{bmatrix}⎣⎡​1−43−12​0103​1−8160​01−816​⎦⎤​⎣⎡​A1​A2​A3​B3​​⎦⎤​=⎣⎡​01−295​⎦⎤​
(15)

Solving numerically gives A1=1A_1 = 1A1​=1, A2=−5A_2 = -5A2​=−5, A3=−1A_3 = -1A3​=−1, and B3=2B_3 =2B3​=2. Finally,

∫x2−29x+5(x−4)2(x2+3)d⁡ ⁣x=∫(1x−4−5(x−4)2−xx2+3+2x2+3)d⁡ ⁣x=ln⁡∣x−4∣+5x−4−12ln⁡∣x2+3∣+23arctan⁡(x3)+c\begin{align} \int &\frac{x^2-29x+5}{(x-4)^2 (x^2+3)} \d{x} \\ &= \int\Biggl(\frac{1}{x-4}-\frac{5}{(x-4)^2} -\frac{x}{x^2+3}+\frac{2}{x^2+3}\Biggr) \d{x} \\ &= \ln|x-4|+\frac{5}{x-4} -\frac{1}{2} \ln|x^2 + 3| + \frac{2}{\sqrt{3}} \arctan\left( \frac{x}{\sqrt{3}} \right) + c \end{align}∫​(x−4)2(x2+3)x2−29x+5​dx=∫(x−41​−(x−4)25​−x2+3x​+x2+32​)dx=ln∣x−4∣+x−45​−21​ln∣x2+3∣+3​2​arctan(3​x​)+c​​
(16)

using u substitution in

∫d⁡ ⁣x1+x2=arctan⁡x\int \frac{\d{x}}{1+x^2} = \arctan x∫1+x2dx​=arctanx
(17)

to evaluate the last integral.

Heaviside cover-up method¶

The Heaviside cover-up method is a simplified approach to finding the coefficients in partial fraction decomposition for linear factors. Its main advantage is avoiding cross-multiplication, which can be time-consuming, by covering up a factor and substituting the appropriate value into the expression.

We will demonstrate the approach by example. Given the decomposition:

3x+11(x−3)(x+2)=A1x−3+A2x+2\frac{3x+11}{(x-3)(x+2)} = \frac{A_1}{x-3} + \frac{A_2}{x+2}(x−3)(x+2)3x+11​=x−3A1​​+x+2A2​​
(18)

Multiply by both sides by the first factor and take the limit to find A1A_1A1​:

lim⁡x→3(3x+11x+2)=lim⁡x→3(A1+A2(x−3)x+2)3(3)+113+2=A1A1=4\begin{align} \lim_{x\to 3} \left( \frac{3x+11}{x+2} \right) &= \lim_{x \to 3} \left( A_1 + \frac{A_2(x-3)}{x+2} \right) \\ \frac{3(3)+11}{3+2} &= A_1 \\ A_1 &= 4 \end{align}x→3lim​(x+23x+11​)3+23(3)+11​A1​​=x→3lim​(A1​+x+2A2​(x−3)​)=A1​=4​​
(19)

You can do the same for the second factor to get A2A_2A2​:

lim⁡x→−2(3x+11x−3)=lim⁡x→−2(A1(x+2)x−3+A2)3(−2)+11−2−3=A2A2=−1\begin{align} \lim_{x\to -2} \left( \frac{3x+11}{x-3}\right) &= \lim_{x\to -2} \left( \frac{A_1(x+2)}{x-3} + A_2 \right) \\ \frac{3(-2)+11}{-2-3} &= A_2 \\ A_2 &= -1 \end{align}x→−2lim​(x−33x+11​)−2−33(−2)+11​A2​​=x→−2lim​(x−3A1​(x+2)​+A2​)=A2​=−1​​
(20)

This procedure can be implemented conveniently by “covering up” the relevant factor in the original fraction!

Heaviside cover-up method

To evaluate the unknown coefficient of the highest power of a linear factor in a partial fraction decomposition, cover-up the factor in the original fraction, then evaluate the fraction with the value of x that makes the factor zero.

Note that this procedure only works for the highest powers of linear factors, but it can be used in combination with other techniques to more easily obtain the remaining factors.

For example, given:

x2−29x+5(x−4)2(x2+3)=A1x−4+A2(x−4)2+A3x+B3x2+3\frac{x^2-29x+5}{(x-4)^2 (x^2 +3)} = \frac{A_1}{x-4} + \frac{A_2}{(x-4)^2} + \frac{A_3x + B_3}{x^2 +3}(x−4)2(x2+3)x2−29x+5​=x−4A1​​+(x−4)2A2​​+x2+3A3​x+B3​​
(21)

A2A_2A2​ can be solved for using the Heaviside cover-up method because it corresponds to the highest power of the factor x−4x-4x−4.

A2=42−29⋅4+542+3=−5A_2 = \frac{4^2 - 29 \cdot 4 + 5}{4^2 + 3} = -5A2​=42+342−29⋅4+5​=−5
(22)

Cross-multiplication must be used to solve for A1A_1A1​, A3A_3A3​, and B3B_3B3​.

Polynomial division¶

Polynomial division is a method used to simplify rational functions when the degree of the numerator PPP is higher than the degree of the denominator QQQ. The remaineder from the division should then be suitable for partial fraction decomposition.

For example, to integrate:

∫x4−5x3+6x2−18x3−3x2d⁡ ⁣x\int \frac{x^4 - 5x^3 + 6x^2 -18}{x^3 -3x^2} \d{x}∫x3−3x2x4−5x3+6x2−18​dx
(23)

Partial fraction decomposition seems useful, but the degree of the numerator P is 4 but the degree of denominator Q is 3, so we must carry out polynomial division first.

x−25x3+6x2−18x3−3x2) x4−5x3+6x2−18‾− (x4−3x3)‾+6x2−18−2x3+6x2−18− (−2x3+6x2)‾−18−18\begin{array}{r} x-2 \phantom{5x^3+6x^2-18}\\ x^3-3x^2{\overline{\smash{\big)}\, x^4-5x^3+6x^2-18}} \\ \underline{-~(x^4-3x^3)}\phantom{+6x^2-18} \\ -2x^3+6x^2-18 \\ \underline{-~(-2x^3+6x^2)}\phantom{-18} \\ -18 \\ \end{array}x−25x3+6x2−18x3−3x2)x4−5x3+6x2−18​− (x4−3x3)​+6x2−18−2x3+6x2−18− (−2x3+6x2)​−18−18​
(24)

The result is

x4−5x3+6x2−18x3−3x2=x−2−18x3−3x2\frac{x^4 - 5x^3 + 6x^2 -18}{x^3 -3x^2} = x - 2 - \frac{18}{x^3-3x^2}x3−3x2x4−5x3+6x2−18​=x−2−x3−3x218​
(25)

Use partial fraction decomposition for the fractional term:

−18x2(x−3)=A1x+A2x2+A3x−3\frac{-18}{x^2 (x-3)} = \frac{A_1}{x} + \frac{A_2}{x^2} + \frac{A_3}{x-3}x2(x−3)−18​=xA1​​+x2A2​​+x−3A3​​
(26)

Find A2A_2A2​ and A3A_3A3​ using the Heaviside cover-up method:

A2=−180−3=6A3=−1832=−2\begin{align} A_2 &= \frac{-18}{0-3} = 6 \\ A_3 &= \frac{-18}{3^2} = -2 \end{align}A2​A3​​=0−3−18​=6=32−18​=−2​​
(27)

Find A1A_1A1​ by substituting A2A_2A2​ and A3A_3A3​, then cross-multiplying:

−18=A1x(x−3)+6(x−3)−2x2-18 = A_1 x (x-3) + 6(x-3) - 2x^2−18=A1​x(x−3)+6(x−3)−2x2
(28)

We could collect powers of x, but plugging in x=1x=1x=1 then solving for A1A_1A1​ is a little easier:

−18=A1⋅1⋅−2+6⋅−2−2=−2A1−14A1=2\begin{align} -18 &= A_1 \cdot 1 \cdot -2 + 6 \cdot -2 - 2 = -2A_1 - 14 \\ A_1 &= 2 \end{align}−18A1​​=A1​⋅1⋅−2+6⋅−2−2=−2A1​−14=2​​
(29)

Last, integrate:

∫x4−5x3+6x2−18x3−3x2d⁡ ⁣x=∫(x−2+2x+6x2−2x−3)d⁡ ⁣x=x22−2x+2ln⁡∣x∣−6x−2ln⁡∣x−3∣+c\begin{align} &\int \frac{x^4 - 5x^3 + 6x^2 -18}{x^3 -3x^2} \d{x} \\ &= \int \left(x - 2 + \frac{2}{x} + \frac{6}{x^2} - \frac{2}{x-3} \right) \d{x} \\ &= \frac{x^2}{2} -2x + 2\ln|x| - \frac{6}{x} - 2\ln|x-3| + c \end{align}​∫x3−3x2x4−5x3+6x2−18​dx=∫(x−2+x2​+x26​−x−32​)dx=2x2​−2x+2ln∣x∣−x6​−2ln∣x−3∣+c​​
(30)

Skill builder problems¶

Integrate the following:

  1. ∫2x+16x2−16d⁡ ⁣x\displaystyle \int \frac{2x+16}{x^2-16} \d{x}∫x2−162x+16​dx

    Fractional decomposition: \begin{equation} \frac{2x+16}{(x+4)(x-4)} = \frac{A_1}{x+4} + \frac{A_2}{x-4} \end{equation} Cover up: \begin{align} A_1 &= \frac{2(-4)+16}{-4-4} = -1 \\ A_2 &= \frac{2(4)+16}{4+4} = 3 \end{align} so \begin{align} \int\frac{2x+16}{x^2-16} \d{x} &= \int\left( -\frac{1}{x+4}+\frac{3}{x-4} \right) \d{x} \\ &= -\ln|x+4| + 3\ln|x-4| + c \end{align}

  2. ∫8x2+2xd⁡ ⁣x\displaystyle \int \frac{8}{x^2+2x} \d{x}∫x2+2x8​dx

    Fractional decomposition: \begin{equation} \frac{8}{x(x+2)} = \frac{A_1}{x} + \frac{A_2}{x+2} \end{equation} Cover up: \begin{align} A_1 &= \frac{8}{0+2} = 4 \\ A_2 &= \frac{8}{-2} = -4 \end{align} so \begin{align} \int\frac{8}{x^2+2x} \d{x} &= \int\left(\frac{4}{x} - \frac{4}{x+2}\right) \d{x} \\ &= 4\ln|x| - 4\ln|x+2| + c \end{align}

  3. ∫5+12x2−x3x2(x−9)(x−1)d⁡ ⁣x\displaystyle \int \frac{5+12x^2-x^3}{x^2(x-9)(x-1)} \d{x}∫x2(x−9)(x−1)5+12x2−x3​dx

    Fractional decomposition \begin{equation} \frac{5+12x^2-x^3}{x^2(x-9)(x-1)} = \frac{A_1}{x} + \frac{A_2}{x^2} + \frac{A_3}{x-9} + \frac{A_4}{x-1} \end{equation} Cover up: \begin{align} A_2 &= \frac{5+12(0^2)-0^3}{(0-9)(0-1)} = \frac{5}{9} \\ A_3 &= \frac{5+12(9^2)-9^3}{9^2(9-1)} = \frac{31}{81} \\ A_4 &= \frac{5+12(1^2)-1^3}{1^2(1-9)} = -2 \end{align} To obtain $A_1$, plugin $x = -1$ \begin{align} \frac{9}{10} &= -A_1 + \frac{5}{9} - \frac{1}{10}\cdot\frac{31}{81} + 1 \\ A_1 &= \frac{50}{81} \end{align} so \begin{align} \int\frac{5+12x^2-x^3}{(x^2)(x-9)(x-1)} \d{x} & =\int\Biggl(\frac{50}{81}\frac{1}{x} + \frac{5}{9}\frac{1}{x^2} + \frac{31}{81}\frac{1}{x-9} - \frac{2}{x-1}\Biggr) \d{x} \\ &= \frac{50}{81}\ln|x| - \frac{5}{9}\frac{1}{x} + \frac{31}{81}\ln|x-5| - 2\ln|x-1| + c \end{align}
